hypotheses.storyTitle: Track Holiday Progress & Apply Statement Credit
hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Daniel reviews his 7,300 coin balance and holiday savings goal progress before executing a direct statement credit redemption.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Daniel visits the rewards overview to check his coin balance and monitor his 53% complete holiday savings goal.
hypotheses.storyTension: Ensuring earned value is clearly visible and directly translatable to bill reduction without navigating irrelevant partner vouchers.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Points and cashback are clearly displayed alongside a one-tap statement credit application shortcut.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Review rewards and execute predictable payment-linked redemptions or goal tracking.
